pick.name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM; Google AI Pro tier)
pick.what: Upload sources (PDFs, sites, YouTube, Docs) and get cited answers, reports, audio/video overviews, slide decks
pick.why: Answers only from your sources, huge Pro limits, and turns interview/market packs into briefings for free.
pick.free_limits: Pro: 500 notebooks, 300 sources/notebook (Google help). Per-day chats/overviews/Deep Research not published by Google (9to5Google May 2026: 500 chats, 20 audio, 20 video, 20 Deep Research). Visible watermark auto-applied in India, cannot be turned off

alts.name: Claude Projects
alts.what: Project knowledge + chat with Claude over uploaded files
alts.why: Better reasoning and writing over the same pack; no audio/video overviews.

alts.name: Obsidian + Claude Code (local markdown vault)
alts.what: Local markdown notes that Claude Code can read/grep
alts.why: Fully local, no lock-in; choose it for healthcare-client material you must not upload.
alts.free_limits: Free for all purposes incl. commercial; optional paid Commercial licence

decision: NotebookLM is the best free source-grounded workspace and Pro limits are far beyond solo needs. Use a local vault + Claude Code instead whenever sources are client-confidential or health data.
details: Google's help page now calls the product 'Gemini Notebook'; 9to5Google (May 2026) still says NotebookLM. Treat the rename as unconfirmed.

verify.note: Rename is real: both Google's plans help page and the Google AI plans page now say 'Gemini Notebook' and never 'NotebookLM'. 500 notebooks / 300 sources confirmed; per-day chat/overview/Deep Research counts are not on Google's page (9to5Google only). Auto visible watermark in India confirmed (Pro toggle does not override it).
